Round 4: FS shows a PA death certificate (1906+) indexed under Mary Gaffney - lead.

bio: FamilySearch attaches two Ancestry index entries to her profile: a 1900 census entry for "Mary Mcguire" and a "Pennsylvania, Death Certificates, 1906-1970" entry under her maiden name, "Mary Gaffney" ([R4-S1]). The second implies she died in Pennsylvania in 1906 or later, outliving her husband Edward (d. 4 Apr 1907) or dying close to him. The certificate would name her parents and Irish birthplace.
openQuestions: Find Mary (Gaffney) McGuire's PA death certificate (Ancestry PA Death Certificates 1906-1970; FS shows an index link) and her death year; search PA death indexes under McGuire, Mary, Plymouth/Larksville after 1906.
